flags.why: Cây cảnh means a plant grown for decoration, whereas a potted plant need not be ornamental.

This cooking sense refers to making soup with meat or fish, spring onions and Vietnamese coriander, rather than generic broth with cilantro ([source](https://tintuconline.com.vn/rau-ram-o-lai-15994.html)).
flags.fix: to cook meat or fish in plenty of water with spring onions and Vietnamese coriander

flags.why: The example uses thuôn with a pot of soup instead of the meat or fish being cooked and substitutes cilantro for the characteristic Vietnamese coriander.
flags.fix: Mẹ thuôn thịt bò với hành và rau răm. = Mum cooked beef soup with spring onions and Vietnamese coriander.

flags.why: Calling someone ma cô in this sense is derogatory, and the colloquial tag does not warn the learner of that.
